review_locator: PMCID:PMC4449733, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in the Lung
primary_title: Interleukin 9 fate reporter reveals induction of innate IL-9 response in lung inflammation
decision_basis: The lung ILC2 review cites the IL-9 fate-reporter primary showing that IL-2 from adaptive immune cells is required for IL-9 production by lung innate lymphoid cells; the primary directly measures IL-9 protein after IL-2 stimulation and neutralization/rescue experiments.
limitations_preserved: Measured IL-9 protein production after IL-2 stimulation is supported in mouse lung ILCs; preserve adaptive-immune-derived IL-2, papain-inflammation and transient ILC context and do not infer an unmeasured Il9 transcription-to-protein step, receptor stoichiometry, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF mechanism.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5712288, Guards at the gate: physiological and pathological roles of tissue-resident innate lymphoid cells in the lung
primary_title: IL-9-mediated survival of type 2 innate lymphoid cells promotes damage control in helminth-induced lung inflammation
decision_basis: The lung ILC review identifies IL-9 as an autocrine ILC2 factor and cites the primary showing IL-9-dependent enhancement of IL-5 production; the primary measures IL-5 protein in sorted lung ILC2 culture supernatants with IL-9 stimulation and Il9r-deficient controls.
limitations_preserved: IL-9R-dependent enhancement of IL-5 protein output is supported in infected mouse lung ILC2 cultures; preserve the autocrine, helminth-recovery and IL-9R context and do not infer direct transcriptional activation, constitutive output, human equivalence, SCI transfer or terminal-TF mechanism.
